synthesis_decision.rationale: [blinded_slot:candidate_a->antithesis] Both artifacts returned the required outputs and met the clock constraints on both public surveys: zero sum to numerical precision and absolute biases no greater than 4 ms. Their worst public errors were essentially identical: 0.112 m for plume location and 12.23 µs for clock RMSE, below the 1.8 m and 250 µs limits. Reported runtimes were 0.0086–0.0088 s for A and 0.0171–0.0193 s for B, both well under 15 s. nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: More search alone can resolve the synthetic corner failures once cycle skips are removed.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: All 13 corner misses had the correct slip mask; in case 2 the truth-start fit still moved 9.73 m, and in cases 28 and 58 the distant fit had lower residual loss than the truth-start fit.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: Near a survey corner, few rays cross the plume core, allowing changes in center and amplitude to generate nearly indistinguishable pick times.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Retain the exact finite-ray model and compare weak, noise-scaled amplitude regularization with the unrestricted fit.

nogoods_recorded.assumption_refuted: A globally sparse slip rate is sufficient for per-receiver robust fitting to identify its true clock mode.
nogoods_recorded.empirical_witness: At 4% overall corruption, the baseline failed the clock target in 74 of 80 same-sign majority cases and 6 of 80 mixed-sign cases; all center estimates still passed.
nogoods_recorded.causal_blanket_diagnosis: When slips dominate one receiver, its fitted offset follows the shifted cluster, and clipping the output afterward cannot recover the correct assignment.
nogoods_recorded.sublated_pivot: Keep the physical plume fit and compare both assignments of a visibly split receiver against the joint, zero-sum traveltime fit.
